question: Should manual Control UI composer height be one browser-local preference shared across chat sessions, as this PR implements, or should it remain session-scoped or non-persistent?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally separated from draft/session state and has credible proof, but the choice determines the durable user-facing preference contract rather than a fact that code review can resolve.

options.title: Approve global preference
options.body: Accept one resettable browser-local composer height so the layout remains consistent while users move between chats.

options.title: Use session-scoped height
options.body: Ask for the stored height to follow an individual chat session if composer dimensions should be part of each conversation workspace.

options.title: Keep resizing non-persistent
options.body: Retain the accessible resize interaction but clear it on reload if persistent layout preferences should remain limited to an existing settings model.

recommendation.title: Approve global preference
recommendation.body: Accept one resettable browser-local composer height so the layout remains consistent while users move between chats.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level Control UI preference-contract decision rather than a contributor repair question.
